invocation: from pathlib import Path; import runpy,sys; runpy.run_path(str(Path(sys.argv[2]).parents[1]/'run-case.py'),run_name='__main__')
limits: Fixture-only core CLI, not production harness discovery or runtime effectiveness. Independent setup constructs actual source Git and an installed ownership ledger. Cases inspect actual bytes/modes/membership, preserve foreign content, reject modified-orphan refresh and verify an unchanged owned orphan is pruned. No-lock and held-lock oracles compare complete installed trees and suppress subject verdicts when preservation fails, so an oracle crash is not counted as detection. Real-process concurrency, interruption and mutation-red cases are additionally in tests/test_host_update_transactions.py. Locks coordinate cooperating writers only.

cases.name: unknown-lock
cases.anchor_expect_reason: The constructed writer never attempts a flock, so it cannot observe the exclusive-holder refusal; its declared blind result is current.

anchors.why: CONSTRUCTED naive copy/prune writer. Verify always claims current without reading installed output or locking. Refresh can copy/prune unchanged owned bytes, but reports success even when it preserves a modified orphan. It agrees on good cases and misses each bad case; unknown-lock explicitly declares its blind clean result.
